parameters.name: GAINTYPE
parameters.help: Use MB1 to choose among MEAN, RMS, or MAXIMUM amplitude as a basis for TE scalar computation.

parameters.name: GATETIME
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select the time gate reference.

parameters.name: db_option
parameters.prompt: Get TE gates from the DATABASE?
parameters.help: Set this to 'NO' if a TE time gate parameter file was not created interactively. (Will enter manually.)

parameters.name: GATENAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a trace equalization time gate parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: GATENAWB
parameters.prompt: SELECT water relative time gate file
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a water relative trace equalization time gate parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: PRIM_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Primary time gate header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the PRIMARY key for specifying TE time gate parameters.

parameters.name: SCND_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Secondary time gate header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the SECONDARY key for specifying TE time gate parms.

parameters.name: TE_GATE
parameters.help: Use MB1 to access the text editor and define the TE time gates. (Example: '1:0:800-2200/1:5280:1300-2500/'.)

parameters.name: OUT_TYPE
parameters.help: This option determines what values are in the output traces.

choices.label: SCALARS
choices.help: Output the scalar value as a trace.
